rule.statement: An order under Section 38 of the Land Acquisition Act gives a conclusive effect and all courts receive it as conclusive evidence of title of the state.
rule.supporting_quote: This being a discretionary remedy of court, cannot afford a statutory right to a litigant, to demand the exercise of a power to revoke the vesting order. Court of Appeal has used its discretion correctly and dismissed the case of the Petitioner.
rule.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 38 of the Land Acquisition Act
